benefits.name: Airport Lounge Access
benefits.description: Complimentary primary cardholder access to Capital One Lounges, Capital One Landings, and Priority Pass lounges.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Up to 4 employee cards can be enrolled for lounge access at $125/year per card. Primary cardholder may bring up to 2 guests into Priority Pass lounges at no charge. Capital One Lounge/Landing guests are complimentary only above $75,000 in annual spend, otherwise $45/adult or $25/child.

benefits.terms: Access subject to space availability, not guaranteed.

benefits.name: Hertz President's Circle Status
benefits.description: Complimentary top-tier Hertz Gold Plus Rewards President's Circle elite status.
benefits.terms: Requires one-time enrollment through the Capital One benefits portal. Grants widest vehicle selection, guaranteed car-class upgrades, and a dedicated service line.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Coverage for damage/theft on most rental cars when the rental is paid for with the card.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties on eligible purchases.
